title: Quantum minimum-cut query lower bounds for weighted graph input models

license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable selection of author arXiv:2011.09823v3 (2021-05-24), CC BY-NC-SA4.0, for noncommercial research with attribution and share-alike retained. The complete independent Section5 lower-bound family, Theorems35,37,40, is grouped as one item across query models and edge-weight regimes, retaining exact integer/divisibility/error promises, both cut-weight and cut-shore tasks, graph constructions, oracle simulations, local claims and proofs. Exact credited connectivity/counting facts33--34, graph definitions and quantum input-oracle models are retained. Original adjacency-gadget PDF and full bibliography retained. Query/time-upper-bound references are presented explicitly by original Theorem21/Section4 numbers; counters resume their original numbers. Original author mathematics is not corrected or supplemented. No upper-algorithm technical by-product is counted as a separate result.

core_obligations: Retain exact weighted graph, integer/divisibility and success-probability promises in all three author main lower bounds.
Keep complete graph constructions, oracle simulations and weight/shore reductions.
Group model and edge-weight regimes; exclude upper-algorithm proofs from this independent main result.
difficulty_reason: The independent lower-bound section constructs weighted graph families that encode exact counting and an AND of threshold promises while hiding minimum-cut alternatives. The array construction uses a separate dense four-part gadget and an explicit one-query adjacency simulation; weight and shore recovery have separate reductions. All model/weight regimes are grouped once.

dedup.scope: Same fully refreshed source identity as NT063. NT063 is an algorithmic upper-bound result; this item is the independent new Section5 query lower-bound family, not an upper-proof support lemma. All parameter/model regimes combined once.
